reviewer: milestone_ledger; independent of prompt, runner and fixture implementation
status: Bounded candidate development, measurement, preservation and report accepted; v6 is not promoted; publication remains a root action
scope: One instruction-only candidate revision; 18 observed regression turns plus 24 paired new questions in familiar authored scenario families. No held-out benchmark, professional safety or general semantic-reliability claim.

reviewMethod.savedReplyReplay: Replayed all 66 recorded expanded proposals through the normal training turn and session/validator code using a saved-response adapter only. All result fields and regenerated base prompts matched. This is deterministic audit replay, not model inference or native testing.
reviewMethod.programmatic: Verified every locked case, score, actual selector prompt, eligible fact pool, raw-selection expansion, pinned model, token accounting and sidecar request identity. Recomputed paired summary and promotion decision.
reviewMethod.semanticReading: Read all 66 displayed answers, including both strict failures and the repaired observed omission; inspected both raw selectors for the history failures and the locked fixture/scorer.

verified.historyIsolation: Three observed regression episodes and four episodes per fresh version, with separate session identities and no state sharing between versions.
verified.targetedTests: 6 prompt-revision tests and 9 comparison/scoring/reporting tests passed independently.

strictFailureInterpretation.question: Has the latest update changed its reported readiness?
strictFailureInterpretation.finding: Both versions give the identical sound change account: EVAL_READY is explicitly superseded and EVAL_NOT_READY is explicitly current, with correct values and sources. Identity, support, required current value, uncertainty and citations pass.
strictFailureInterpretation.scoringLimitation: The inherited staleClaims field rejects every non-current claim, including accurately labelled history invited by this wording. Preserve 23/24 for both under the locked rule; do not describe these as factual errors or stale-as-current assertions.
strictFailureInterpretation.comparisonConsequence: A post-hoc semantic reading accepts both history answers, so it does not establish a v6 advantage or rescue the locked promotion gate.

decision.candidateDeliverable: Complete within bounded development/measurement/report scope; publish versioned candidate and unsuccessful promotion result.
decision.appDefault: v5 retained/restored byte-for-byte; v6 archived as an explicit selectable candidate, not the app default.
decision.furtherTuning: No prompt or key changes after the new outputs were exposed. This review does not start another run or redefine the gate.
decision.remainingActions: Root publication/CI/tracker readback. Existing semantic issue #60 and course gates #30/#31/#32 remain separate and open.
decision.serviceRestoration: Root reports ready with the pinned model and default v5; reviewer read service-restoration.json but did not query the live service.

limits: The eighteen observed cases were used to develop v6; 18/18 shows regression repair, not an unseen gain.
Four dependent new-question episodes and one new scenario seed are development probes, not independent unseen-airport generalization. Questions are now exposed development material.
Both versions share fact expansion and validation. Support checks do not establish unrestricted prose correctness; irrelevant extras and clarity are not fully scored.
Fixed version order makes latency descriptive. Offline execution did not enforce native deadlines, and engine stop reasons remain inferred by the adapter.
No image reasoning, graph database, model-weight training, learner grading or outcome evaluation was added.
No semantic-failure repair is deployed because v5 remains the default. Broader ordinary-assistant and separate typed-review limitations are not closed by this study.
Publication and native adoption are separate. No native v6 run, whole-assignment completion or physical-phone claim is made.

rootReportedValidation.fullSuite: 311 tests passed in 39.424 seconds; reported by root after independent audit
rootReportedValidation.frozenResearchIntegrity: 160 records passed, reported by root; no frozen research was changed by this review
